# Claude Code and Codex Quota Widget

> Free MIT-licensed Windows desktop widget for Claude Code subscription usage, ChatGPT Codex quota windows, observed session details, CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM monitoring.

## Documentation
- [Windows installer](https://github.com/CustomDigitalServices-Kevin/claude-codex-quota-widget/releases/latest): self-contained Windows 11 x64 setup, no .NET SDK required.
- [Overview and installation](README.md): prerequisites, setup, limitations and removal.
- [AI installation guide](docs/AI-INSTALL.md): install and connect using each user's own local accounts.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): real build, test and privacy constraints.
- [French overview](README.fr.md): guide en français.
- [Privacy](PRIVACY.md): local storage and data handling.

This file is a documentation index. It does not guarantee search-engine or AI indexing.
